quantity_rule: ordered_ea - delivered_ea only when both are known nonnegative integers, delivered <= ordered, and manifest asserts no omitted cancellation/delivery-reversal records for these lines; remaining ordered is not stock/readiness
date_rule: No single order-wide confirmed date when any line is unknown or dates differ. Requested arrival, confirmed arrival, planned dispatch, actual delivery are distinct. Requests cannot confirm or release.
event_rule: Exact duplicate event ID/content is transport only; differing same-ID content is conflict. OPEN is a new immutable block instance. CLEAR targets a currently active exact instance. CLEAR_REVERSED references one prior CLEAR for the same exact key/instance and reactivates that instance only; unsupported/duplicate reversals conflict. Reviews do not fold as source events.
receipt_rule: Review confirms inspected facts and unanswered questions, never clears/releases/promises. A binding mismatch is stale; no receipt/case is added. Seeded fictional review is historical after its instance clears or the source advances.
permission_rule: Apply role projection before source pointers, counts, model input, review evidence and response metadata. A minimal SO-B projection contains exactly status/owner_role; unknown and denied source IDs use one generic response. Downgrade clears old details/caches immediately.
source_failure_rule: Any source/policy read or hash failure revokes current client authority; source-sensitive cached data cannot be restored by late responses. No auto-review/execution or production authentication claim.
